events.titleEn: 500th anniversary of the first written mention of Griblje — solemn mass
events.descriptionSi: Griblje so obeležile 500 let prve pisne omembe (1526 — gradnja predhodnice cerkve sv. Vida, hkrati prva omemba vasi): svečana maša v Gribljah, ki jo je pozdravil tudi župnik z ozaveščanjem jubileja krajev ob Kolpi. Vir: Radio Odeon (23. 6. 2026).
events.descriptionEn: Griblje marked 500 years since the first written mention (1526 — the building of the predecessor of St. Vitus' church, also the first mention of the village): a solemn mass in Griblje celebrating the jubilee of the places along the Kolpa. Source: Radio Odeon (23 June 2026).

events.titleEn: Butoraj and Griblje — joint celebration of the 500th anniversaries
events.descriptionSi: V Beli krajini so leta 2026 obeležili pomemben cerkveni jubilej, ki povezuje preteklost, vero in kulturno dediščino krajev ob Kolpi: v Butoraju in Gribljah so slovesno mašo skupaj proslavili obeh 500-letnic prve omembe. Vir: Slovenske novice/Delo (13. 8. 2026).
events.descriptionEn: In 2026 Bela krajina marked an important church jubilee linking the past, faith and the cultural heritage of the places along the Kolpa: Butoraj and Griblje celebrated their two 500th anniversaries of first mention with a joint solemn mass. Source: Slovenske novice/Delo (13 Aug 2026).

events.titleEn: Open day of the digital museum
events.descriptionSi: Prvi javni ogled nove digitalne zbirke: kako beremo evidence oznake, kako brskamo po zemljevidu in kako vsak domačin doda svoj vir.
events.descriptionEn: The first public viewing of the new digital collection: how to read evidence marks, browse the map, and how every local adds their own source.
events.locationEn: Griblje — by the church of St. Vitus

events.titleSi: Delavnica ustne zgodovine: zbiramo spomine Gribelj
events.titleEn: Oral-history workshop: collecting the memories of Griblje
events.descriptionSi: Učna delavnica za domačine: kako se posname pričevanje, kaj je soglasje in kako iz spomina nastane muzejski zapis.
events.descriptionEn: A learning workshop for locals: how a testimony is recorded, what consent means, and how a memory becomes a museum record.

events.titleSi: 40 let odkritja črnega močerila — naravoslovna ura ob izviru
events.titleEn: 40 years since the black olm's discovery — a nature hour at the spring
events.descriptionSi: Ob 40. obletnici odkritja črne človeške ribice (18. oktobra 1986) se sprehodimo do izvira Jelševniščice v Jelševniku — edinega kraja na svetu, kjer črnega močerila lahko opazujemo v naravi. Vodena ura o podzemlju, ki ga deli z Gribljami.
events.descriptionEn: Marking forty years since the discovery of the black olm (18 October 1986), we walk to the Jelševniščica spring at Jelševnik — the only place on Earth where the black olm can be observed in nature. A guided hour on the underground it shares with Griblje.

events.titleSi: Vinogradniški sprehod: od grozdja do črnine
events.titleEn: Vineyard walk: from grape to črnina
events.descriptionSi: Vodeni sprehod po vinogradih ob robu vasi z degustacijo belokranjskih vin; zberemo fotografije zidnic za zbirko.
events.descriptionEn: A guided walk through the vineyards at the village edge with a tasting of Bela krajina wines; we collect photographs of zidnice for the collection.

events.titleSi: 150 let od rojstva Nika Županiča — muzej odpira spominski zapis
events.titleEn: 150 years since the birth of Niko Županič — the museum opens its memorial record
events.descriptionSi: Ob 150-letnici rojstva gribeljskega etnologa (1. 12. 1876) predstavimo zapis o njem in iščemo rodbinske fotografije ter spomine domačinov.
events.descriptionEn: On the 150th anniversary of the Griblje ethnologist's birth (1 Dec 1876) we present his record and look for family photographs and villagers' memories.
events.locationSi: Griblje — digitalni muzej (na spletu) in spominska plošča v vasi
events.locationEn: Griblje — the digital museum (online) and the memorial plaque in the village

events.titleEn: 82nd anniversary of the Allied evacuation — memory walk
events.descriptionSi: Spominski pohod po poteh ranjencev marca 1945: od gozda do poljane pri Gribljah, z branjem dokumentov zbirke.
events.descriptionEn: A memorial walk along the paths of the wounded of March 1945: from the forest to the field at Griblje, with readings from the collection's documents.
events.locationSi: Griblje — prihod bo natančen z viri
events.locationEn: Griblje — details to be confirmed with sources

events.descriptionSi: Največji festival slovenskega ljudskega ustvarjanja v Črnomlju: jurji, maske, pesem in ples celotne regije.
events.descriptionEn: The largest festival of Slovene folk creativity in Črnomelj: jurji, masks, song and dance of the whole region.

events.titleEn: One hundred years of the Griblje fire brigade (1927–2027)
events.descriptionSi: Prostovoljno gasilsko društvo Griblje, ustanovljeno 1927, praznuje stoletnico: 140 članov, od tega 18 operativnih gasilcev, gasilski dom s spominsko sobo dr. Franca Brinca in stoletje pomoči vasi. Muzej ob jubileju dopolnjuje zapis o društvu — točen datum bo potrdilo društvo samo.
events.descriptionEn: The Griblje volunteer fire brigade, founded in 1927, celebrates its centenary: 140 members, 18 of them operational firefighters, a fire station with the memorial room of dr. Franc Brinc, and a century of service to the village. For the jubilee the museum is expanding its record of the brigade — the exact date to be confirmed by the society itself.

events.titleEn: The Pasuljada — a bean-stew cooking contest
events.descriptionSi: Avgustovska šega TD Griblje z Društvom kmečkih žena in kopališčem: štirinajst ekip po dva člana kuha pasulj na odprtem ognju, komisija pa išče lonec leta. Zapis o Pasuljadi v zbirki muzeja pripoveduje, kako iz šale zraste tradicija.
events.descriptionEn: The August custom of the Griblje Tourist Society with the Farm Women's Society and the bathing place: fourteen two-member teams cook bean stew over open fire while the jury seeks the pot of the year. The museum's record of the Pasuljada tells how a joke grows into a tradition.
